mode: Built-in image_gen, transparent precise-object-edit; approved hollow crossing-filament previews
inputs: Hollow outline previews were edited without changing pose. Perimeter filaments cross; the center remains transparent. The engine renders actual traced afterglow separately.

prompts.name: Draco
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this HOLLOW outline sprite. KEEP ITS EMPTY INTERIOR EXACTLY EMPTY. Keep pose, contours, scale, proportions and framing unchanged.
Change only the SINGLE WHITE PERIMETER LINE: make it THREE FINE FILAMENTS that loosely cross each other, diverge, then converge again along the same existing perimeter. The three paths are close together, staying within roughly 15 pixels of the original white perimeter. They should gracefully intersect every so often, forming elongated tapered overlapping loops ALONG THE BORDER. Cyan, white-blue and lavender. Organic loose flowing intersections, not a rigid regular braid.
Preserve the original transparent inner body channel from head to tail. Do not draw ANY new line across that hollow central channel. Do not add any body fill. Maintain exactly the negative space that is already present. The whole center stays transparent; only the edge gets multiple crossing lines.
Reduce the existing thick purple outer glow to a much narrower faint halo around the new filaments. Use delicate fine strokes; remove all broad purple colored bands, noise and haze. No interior textures, gradients, light strands, dots or stars. No extra features or anatomy. Actual transparent background and transparent hollow interior. Return just this single revised sprite, no text.
Figure: Draco
